questions.stem: 50 year old woman with T2DM is brought by her family due to strange behaviour. Her daughter tells that she noticed that her mother on her wedding was applying makeup only to the left side of her face and eats food from only the left half of her plate. When asked to copy simple shapes such as a triangle, square, and circle her drawings are incomplete and poorly organized. Which of the following brain regions is most likely affected?
